name: spot-interruption-storm
why_hard: Thirty pods restart within two minutes and every application log says the same thing: lost connection to Redis. The obvious cause is Redis. Redis is healthy and answering; the pods restarted because the Spot node they all sat on was reclaimed by EC2 with a two-minute notice, Karpenter drained it, and the new node came up 90 seconds later. The evidence is in node events and the interruption-notice log, not in any application log.
